{{Top|ga}} {{Otheruses|Mytus}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Mytus_Adema.png]] |name=Mytus Adema |homeworld=[[Planetoid A.17]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|lieutenant-mytus-adema|Lieutenant Mytus Adema}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Green |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Officer Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Sir, unauthorized access at the data vault.''"
"''What?''"
"''It's just come in, sir.|Mytus Adema and Director Krennic|audio=Adema-UnathorizedAccess.flac|}} '''Mytus Adema''' was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Citadel Tower]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]]. An ambitious [[Gender|man]] who disliked his [[Commanding officer|superior officer]], [[General]] [[Sotorus Ramda]], Adema hoped to one [[Standard day|day]] make a damning report on the general's behavior. Adema was on duty in the Citadel's command center in [[1 BBY]], when [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] of Imperial [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research]] arrived to retrieve information on communications made by [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]]. Shortly after Krennic's arrival, a series of explosions visible from the command center marked the beginning of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Scarif|attack on the Citadel]] aimed at [[Thief|stealing]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. During the fighting, Adema was fooled by false reports of rebel activity on several of the Citadel's landing pads but also reported to Krennic the rebels' genuine attempt to access the tower's [[Scarif vault|data vault]]. Foiling Krennic's efforts to stop them, the rebels successfully transmitted the plans to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] in [[orbit]], before the Death Star itself obliterated the Citadel with a blast from its [[superlaser]]. ==Biography== ===Krennic arrives=== {{Quote|Galen Erso. I want every dispatch, every transmission he has ever sent, called up for inspection.|Director Krennic gives an order that makes Mytus Adema flinch|audio=Krennic-IWantEveryFile.flac|}} [[File:Adema_Krennic_and_Ramda.png|thumb|right|300px|Mytus Adema (right) witnesses Director Krennic's arrival at the Citadel Tower.]] Mytus Adema''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from [[Planetoid A.17]] in the [[Toria-vic Nebula]] of [[Wild Space]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} who worked as a [[lieutenant]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]]. Adema was stationed in the [[Citadel Tower]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[General]] [[Sotorus Ramda]]. He was present in the Citadel's command center when [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] of the Empire's [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research]] division arrived there to retrieve from the facility's archives all recorded correspondence ever sent by Imperial [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]]. Krennic's order caused Adema and every other [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the room, save Ramda, to flinch due to the sheer number of records involved.''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' As Krennic waited for the correspondence to be delivered, a series of distant explosions visible from the command center were set off by a [[Rogue One|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel trooper|soldiers]] that had infiltrated Scarif's defenses in order to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] from the Citadel. Adema and the other Imperials in the command center watched in shocked silence through the room's [[viewport]] until Krennic yelled at them to mobilize the Citadel's [[stormtrooper]] [[garrison]] and respond to the attack. ===The battle begins=== {{Quote|This is Pad Five, we're being overrun. Help us!''"
"''Pad Twelve! Pad Ten! Pad Eight! Please confirm! Confirm and report! Get reinforcements down to Pad Five!|Alliance Corporal Stordan Tonc tricks Mytus Adema into sending reinforcements to the wrong location|audio=ToncAndAdema.flac|}} As fighting broke out between the rebel and Imperial forces around the Citadel, Adema began receiving requests for help and anomalous reports of large numbers of rebel attackers sighted at several of the Citadel's landing pads. Some of these reports were genuine, but others, including those from [[Pad Two]] and [[Pad Five]], were false attempts by defected Imperial [[pilot]] [[Bodhi Rook]] and fellow rebel [[Corporal]] [[Stordan Tonc]] from aboard the stolen [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|Imperial cargo shuttle]] [[SW-0608]] on [[Landing Platform Nine|Pad Nine]] to distract the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. Adema fell for the ruse and, after asking for confirmation from [[Pad Twelve|Pads Twelve]], [[Pad Ten|Ten]], and [[Pad Eight|Eight]], ordered that men be sent to Pad Five, where no rebels were actually fighting. [[File:Adema_reports_to_Krennic.png|thumb|left|300px|Reporting the rebels' access of the data vault]] Shortly after being fooled, Adema received a report of unauthorized access in the Citadel's [[Scarif vault|data vault]], as a three-person rebel team had sneaked inside the tower to find the Death Star plans while the battle raged outside as a diversion. Adema immediately reported the new development to Krennic, who was reading through the Galen Erso correspondences he had received so far.[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] Krennic quickly worked out what was happening and left to confront the rebels in the [[Data vault|vault]] with two [[death trooper]]s. In an attempt to prevent the [[battle station]]'s plans from falling into rebel hands, the Empire destroyed the Citadel soon after with the Death Star's [[superlaser]]. Nevertheless, the rebels on the ground succeeded in transmitting the stolen plans from the planet's surface to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] in [[orbit]] prior to their [[death]]s, ultimately allowing the Rebel Alliance to destroy the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin]].{{Film|IV}} ==Personality and traits== Mytus Adema was a zealous, purposeful, and unusually ambitious young [[officer]] who disdained General Ramda's command of the Citadel Tower as overconfident and lazy. Adema watched his commanding officer's actions closely in the hopes of one day being able to provide a damning report on the general, thus supplanting him in the [[eye]]s of Director Krennic. Adema considered the Death Star a welcome and potent symbol of Imperial might that should be respected. When reporting the unauthorized access of the Citadel's data vault to Krennic, Adema's head twitched to the side, seeking support from other officers in the control center, but he received none. Adema had light skin, [[Color|green]] eyes, and brown [[hair]]. He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]] with an aristocratic accent. ==Equipment== While on duty at the Citadel Tower, Adema wore a standard [[gaberwool]] [[Imperial military uniforms|Imperial officer's uniform]], including a [[Imperial kepi|cap]] with an [[officer's disk]]. He carried a private [[datapad]] in a shockproof case on his [[belt]], the buckle of which also bore an officer's disk, and wore a [[code cylinder]] and a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his breast. The plaque showed two red squares and one blue. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|There's a security team already in place, but no details about the intruders. We're waiting for more now—|Mytus Adema's additional lines of dialogue in the ''Rogue One'' novelization|}} Lieutenant Adema was portrayed by [[Jack Roth]] in the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which was released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books}} The character's name was listed in the film's credits despite never being spoken in the film itself. Actor [[Scott Stevenson]] also acted as the stand-in for Adema, with the character's scenes being filmed throughout [[June]] and [[July]], 2016.{{EmailCite|email=File:ScottStevensonEmail.png|creator=[[Scott Stevenson]]|date=2023-12-28}} Adema's first name, Mytus, was revealed in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published the same day as the film's release. The film's [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|novelization]], written by [[Alexander Freed]], includes additional lines of dialogue for Adema when he speaks with Director Krennic that are not present in the film. ==Appearances== *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st|[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|film novelization]] and ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]''}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Mytus Adema|soundcat=Audio files of Mytus Adema}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Mytus}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|lieutenant-mytus-adema|Lieutenant Mytus Adema}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Mytus Adema |fr=Mytus Adema |ja=マイタス・アデマ |pl=Mytus Adema }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Adema, Mytus}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]]
